entries.title: Need help?
entries.response: It looks like you need assistance. Please describe your issue clearly and a staff member will help, or open a ticket with `/ticket`.

entries.title: Installation help
entries.response: If you are having trouble installing or updating, include what platform you are on, what step fails, and any error code you see. That gives support enough detail to help quickly.

entries.title: Account linking help
entries.summary: Linking game, website, or platform accounts
entries.response: If account linking is failing, share which platforms you are connecting and the exact step where it stops working. A screenshot or exact error message helps a lot.

entries.title: Security help
entries.summary: Suspicious activity or account safety concerns
entries.response: If you think your account or profile was compromised, explain what changed, when it happened, and whether you still have access. Open a ticket right away if the issue is active.

entries.title: Connection help
entries.summary: Login, server, or matchmaking connection issues
entries.response: If you cannot connect, include your region, platform, and whether the issue happens during login, matchmaking, or joining a server. If there is an error message, include it exactly.

entries.title: Access issue help
entries.summary: Missing access, permissions, or locked features
entries.response: If you are missing access to a feature, channel, or server area, explain what you expected to access and what is currently blocked. Staff can check roles, permissions, or account status from there.

entries.title: Bug report help
entries.summary: Report a bug the useful way
entries.response: If you are reporting a bug, include what you expected, what happened instead, when it happened, and any screenshots or logs. That makes support much faster.

entries.title: Ticket help
triggers: how do i make a ticket
entries.response: Use `/ticket` for the normal support flow, or press the Open Ticket button below if this auto-response applies to your issue.

entries.title: Report or review help
entries.summary: Reports, appeals, moderation review, or disputed actions
entries.response: If you need staff to review a report or action, explain what happened clearly, include usernames or IDs if relevant, and share any evidence or context that supports your case.
